title: manifest.json: the record of one build of a face
description: Written by scripts/build.py beside the woff2 files and read by build.py --check, update-check.py and the font suite. It is the face folder's only record of what built its fonts: the hashes of the inputs and of the skill's font sources, the tool versions, and per group the measurements the build took. `skill_version` (0.8.0) is the VERSION of the skill that built it and is optional here because a manifest built before 0.8.0 has none. Keys not listed here are allowed, at the top level and in each group entry, so a later skill can add one and a v1 reader stays valid; each group entry must carry its file, italic flag, woff2 hash and size, axes, instances and masters.

skill_version.description: the VERSION of the skill that built this face; absent in a manifest built before 0.8.0

version.description: the face's own version (font.json `version`), not the skill's

skeletons.description: the face's skeleton override, present only when font.json names one

requirements.description: the requirements file the build ran with, relative to font.json where it can be; null for a --no-requirements build

sources_sha256.description: sha256 of each source: the skill's gen.js, export.js and build.py, the face's font.json and concepts.js, and its skeletons file by name

tools.description: versions of node, fontTools, brotli, skia-pathops, Pillow and Python on the machine that built it
